statement: Axod trusts bridge events or directs termination only after a current bridge connection authenticates and Pi proves every launch-bound session/pane/transcript/cwd/process identity field. Pane recovery reserves an unavailable pane under the catalog lock and commits only if that exact runtime reservation remains current; close, shutdown or a newer recovery fences late callbacks and launches. The connection carries one UUID stream with strictly increasing safe-integer sequences and bounded event names/payloads. Non-explicit recovery does not terminate an active Pi; explicit restart signals only its verified process group, and transcript takeover proceeds only after the inherited exclusive writer lock is released.
consequence: A stale, misbound or forged Pi bridge could corrupt session identity/history or cause Axod to signal an unrelated process; unguarded takeover could disrupt active agent work or race two transcript writers.

enforcedAt.trigger: Axod receives bridge data or requests takeover
